title: Historical National Population Estimates: July 1, 1900 to July 1, 1999
publisher: Population Estimates Program, Population Division, U.S. Census Bureau
source_relation: The source URL is the official URL cited by Problem 16 of Pressbooks record 48.
source_notes: The source states that 1900–1949 exclude Alaska and Hawaii.
The source states that 1940–1979 cover the resident population plus Armed Forces overseas; other years cover only the resident population.
The source states that 1900–1929 values are rounded to the nearest thousand.
